title: Internet and Information: Main Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: Write the HTML code for adding an e-mail link.
Which protocol assigns IP address to the client connected in the internet?
Explain the following terms as used in Internet Fundamentals; i. WWW ii. Internet iii. ISP iv. IP Address v. FTP
Discuss any FIVE advantages of joining a computer network.

items.text: Section B ANSWER ANY TWO QUESTIONS (EACH CARRY 20 MARKS)
Outline the basic steps that should be followed when creating web pages.
Write a brief history of the internet noting the major progress to this day.
Explain FIVE different protocols that support the different services offered by the internet.
Describe the hardware and software you need in order to connect a stand-alone computer to the Internet and start conducting email correspondence and searching.
